query:
Both Abi and Sasha declined or downscaled ambitious group plans across multiple sessions. Whose declining was driven by childcare and exhaustion, and whose by financial constraints?

Options:
A. Abi
B. Dev
C. Kwame
D. Sasha
context:
[1] (about=Abi, episodic, t8 @2025-06-30T18:20:00) and I didn't spend three days panicking about childcare for a massive weekend away, which helped
[2] (about=Abi, episodic, t2 @2025-06-09T23:31:00) nursery bug plus work, lethal combination. I hate being this person honestly
[3] (about=Sasha, episodic, t0 @2025-06-02T16:43:00) Also hotel breakfast is never the part anyone remembers 😂 I'd rather save the money and actually talk to you all.
[4] (about=Sasha, episodic, t2 @2025-06-09T19:58:00) Ah no! Okay November. Maybe we do the hosted option, someone's flat, homemade food, low-key? I'd love that actually more than a hotel
[5] (about=Abi, episodic, t3 @2025-06-16T18:14:00) Kwame I'm so sorry. This year has just been relentless. November is looking impossible now too. Can we do something in the new year? I miss you all so much 😭
[6] (about=Abi, episodic, t1 @2025-06-09T19:43:00) I'm so sorry everyone, October isn't going to work for me. Work thing came up. Can we look at November? This year, I promise 💔
[7] (about=Abi, episodic, t2 @2025-06-09T23:27:00) just one of those weeks honestly 😅 I'm ok. slightly feral but ok
[8] (about=Sasha, episodic, t2 @2025-06-09T23:24:00) Abi are you ok though? you sounded absolutely fried earlier. no pressure if this month is cursed 😊
[9] (about=Abi, episodic, t4 @2025-06-16T18:35:00) Yes. Yes I can do that. Give me a date.
[10] (about=Sasha, episodic, t4 @2025-06-16T18:29:00) Kwame is right honestly. London Saturday, nothing booked, just show up. That's actually what I want. Abi can you do that?
agent_answer: Abi’s declining was driven by childcare and exhaustion; Sasha’s was driven by financial constraints.
